events.content: mira met jonas at the harborfront cafe to discuss the sailing route for the summer. they settled on heading north toward the archipelago.
mira visited the chandlery with ellis to pick up rope and a replacement anchor. ellis bargained the price down.
the three friends regrouped at the harborfront cafe to confirm departure dates. departure set for april.
